faq.title: Questions before we work together.
faq.lead: Price, deliverables, timing and options after launch.

o1.a: It is the minimum starting price, not a fixed price for every website or application. Cost depends on pages, features, integrations, materials, languages and deadlines. We agree cost, deliverables and stages before starting; additional services are not automatically included.

o3.q: What do I receive and what should I prepare?
o3.a: Your quote specifies pages, design, development, mobile adaptation and contact methods. We agree revisions, materials, access and included services. SEO, GEO and AEO can cover technical structure and content within the agreed scope; they do not guarantee rankings or AI recommendations.

o9.q: How long does the project take?
o9.a: A website is estimated at around four weeks. Exact timing depends on complexity, materials and approvals and is agreed before work starts. Complex applications and integrations have their own estimates.

o4.q: Are there additional or recurring costs?
o4.a: Domain, hosting, licences and post-launch services are specified in the quote. Google Ads, Meta Ads and ongoing SEO are optional and quoted separately. Media spend is distinct from management fees. We do not automatically activate subscriptions.

o6.q: What support and guarantee do I have after launch?
o6.a: The first 30 days of support are included within the agreed scope. Maintenance and new development afterwards are quoted separately. The existing guarantee is measured as follows: The baseline is set at kickoff: your current conversion rate if you already have analytics, or a target agreed together if we start from zero. It is measured 90 days after launch, on the same traffic sources. If it has not passed the baseline, we keep working at no cost until it does.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro_body: alcaziurobert.ro is the personal website (professional portfolio) of Alcaziu Robert, a natural person residing in Romania, acting as data controller under GDPR. The site sells nothing online and processes no payments. This policy explains what data I collect when you visit the site or contact me, how I use it, and what rights you have under GDPR (EU Regulation 2016/679).
privacy.data_body: Identification and contact data: name, email address, phone number, and any other information you choose to send me voluntarily. Data from your message: the project type and the optional text you write in the form. Technical and usage data: IP address, session identifiers, browser and device information, pages visited, traffic source, and your consent preferences. Data collected through cookies and similar technologies, to the extent they are enabled according to your choice.
privacy.source_body: I normally collect data directly from you, when you fill out the contact form or send me an email. Some technical data is generated automatically by your browser, by the infrastructure running the site (the hosting server), or by third-party providers activated only based on your consent.
privacy.purpose_body: To respond to your requests and provide information about my services. Basis: pre-contractual steps at your request and legitimate interest. To operate, secure, and administer the site, including preventing abuse, debugging, and technical monitoring. Basis: legitimate interest. To measure traffic and improve site performance through analytics tools. Basis: your consent, when required. To comply with tax, accounting, or other applicable legal obligations. Basis: legal obligation. For defending or exercising my rights in case of disputes or claims. Basis: legitimate interest. I use Google Analytics for traffic measurement and the Meta Pixel for Facebook/Instagram ad measurement, both strictly based on the consent you give through the cookie banner; without consent, neither loads.
privacy.refusal_body: You have no general legal obligation to provide your data. However, if you don't send me the minimum necessary data (name, email, phone), I won't be able to respond to your request or discuss a potential project.
privacy.recipients_body: I may disclose data, strictly to the extent necessary, to providers who help me operate the site: Hosterion (site hosting, servers in Romania) and the email provider used for SMTP on my own domain. If you consent to performance cookies, Google (Google Analytics) also processes aggregated traffic data; if you consent to marketing cookies, Meta Platforms Ireland processes browsing data through the Meta Pixel, plus the name, email, and phone from the contact form in SHA-256 hashed form (Advanced Matching), for advertising measurement — see the Cookie Policy for details. Data may also be disclosed to consultants, accountants, lawyers, public authorities, or courts, if required by law or necessary for defending my rights.
privacy.transfers_body: Hosting and email stay inside the European Union, so contact form data does not leave the European Economic Area. Transfers to the United States occur only for the services you consent to: Google (Google Analytics) and Meta (Meta Pixel). For such transfers I rely on mechanisms recognized by GDPR, such as Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) or other adequate safeguards provided through Data Processing Agreements (DPA).
privacy.storage_body: Commercial inquiry and contact form data: up to 24 months from the last relevant interaction, unless a contractual relationship or a longer legal retention obligation arises. Data needed for invoicing or accounting (in case of subsequent collaboration): for the duration required by applicable tax legislation (generally 10 years). Technical data and security logs: for limited periods, proportional to security and maintenance purposes (usually up to 12 months). Cookie preferences: as described in the Cookie Policy or according to browser settings.
privacy.rights_body: Under GDPR, you have the following rights: right of access to your data, right to rectification, right to erasure, right to restriction of processing, right to object (including to processing based on legitimate interest), right to data portability, right to withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing prior to withdrawal, and the right to lodge a complaint with the Romanian National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP). To exercise these rights, write to contact@alcaziurobert.ro. I respond within a maximum of 30 days.
privacy.cookies_body: I use strictly necessary cookies for site functionality (session, language, and your cookie preference itself). With your consent, I use Google Analytics for performance/analytics and the Meta Pixel for advertising measurement (Facebook/Instagram). A consent banner lets you accept all cookies, accept only necessary ones, or customize your choice by category (necessary, performance, marketing) at any time — see the full Cookie Policy for details on each category, third-party partners, and retention periods.
privacy.security_body: I apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, or unpermitted disclosure: TLS-encrypted transmission, hosting with a server-level firewall and DDoS protection, regular backups. However, no online system can guarantee absolute security.
privacy.changes_body: I may periodically update this policy to reflect legislative, operational, or technical changes. The version published on the site is the version applicable on the date of consultation. I encourage you to check it periodically.
privacy.contact_body: For any request related to data protection or exercising your rights, write to contact@alcaziurobert.ro.

banner.heading: Cookies on alcaziurobert.ro
banner.body1: Cookies remember your preferences, adjust the content shown, and help the site work better on repeat visits. I use trusted external partners for analytics, personalization, and advertising.
banner.body2: Accepting all means the full experience; only essential cookies keep the site running in its basic form. You can change this anytime.

modal.title: Privacy preference center
modal.intro: What is a cookie? A cookie is a file saved on your device when you visit a website. It lets the site remember your settings and preferences on your next visit, for a better browsing experience. You can allow or refuse cookies, but if you refuse, some site sections may not work. Cookies cannot run programs or transmit viruses to your device. You can also select which cookies to accept, by category: strictly necessary, performance, and marketing cookies.

necessary.title: Strictly Necessary Cookies
necessary.description: These cookies are required for the site to function. They typically only respond to actions you take, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in, or filling out forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site won't work. These cookies don't store personally identifiable information.
necessary.row_consent_purpose: Remembers your choice in this panel so you are not asked on every visit. Stored locally, it goes nowhere.
necessary.row_lang_purpose: Remembers the language you selected (Romanian or English). Stored locally.

performance.title: Performance Cookies
performance.description: These cookies let me count visits and traffic sources, so I can measure and improve the site's performance. They help me know which pages are most popular and how visitors move around the site. All information collected is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you don't allow these cookies, I won't know when you visited the site.
performance.partner_ga_description: Google Analytics — measures traffic and pages visited, aggregated and anonymised, so I know what works on the site.

marketing.title: Marketing and Targeting Cookies
marketing.description: This category powers advertising measurement. It loads the Meta Pixel (Facebook/Instagram ads) only after you accept — nothing is sent to Meta beforehand, and you can withdraw consent at any time.
marketing.partner_meta_description: Meta Pixel — measures which Facebook/Instagram ads bring visitors and builds campaign audiences. With Advanced Matching on, the name, email, and phone from the form are sent SHA-256 hashed, never in plain text.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro_body: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies and similar technologies alcaziurobert.ro uses, why, and how you can control them. It complements the Privacy Policy, which covers personal data more broadly — read that page for details on data recipients, retention periods, and your GDPR rights.
cookiePolicy.what_are_cookies_body: A cookie is a small file saved on your device when you visit a website. It lets the site remember your settings and preferences on your next visit, so you get a better browsing experience. Cookies cannot run programs or transmit viruses to your device.
cookiePolicy.necessary_body: These cookies are required for the site to function — for example remembering your language and your cookie preference itself. They don't require consent and can't be turned off from the preference center, but you can block them from your browser settings, at the cost of some site features not working.
cookiePolicy.performance_body: With your consent, I use Google Analytics to measure visits and traffic sources, understand which pages are most useful, and improve the site over time. Data collected this way is aggregated and used for statistics, not to identify you individually. These cookies only load after you accept the "Performance" category in the cookie banner.
cookiePolicy.marketing_body: This category covers advertising cookies. One partner is active: the Meta Pixel (Facebook/Instagram), which sets the _fbp cookie — valid for up to 3 months — to measure which ads bring visitors and conversions and to build campaign audiences. The pixel has Automatic Advanced Matching enabled, so the details you enter in the contact form (name, email, phone) are SHA-256 hashed in the browser and sent to Meta in that form, for conversion matching. All of it loads only after you accept this category; if you decline or withdraw consent, nothing is sent to Meta.
cookiePolicy.third_party_body: Two third-party providers can set cookies here. Google Analytics (performance category) sets _ga and _ga_<container-id> — see Google's Privacy Policy. The Meta Pixel (marketing category) sets _fbp, valid for up to 3 months, and is used to measure and target Facebook/Instagram ad campaigns — see Meta's Cookie Policy. Both load only after you accept the matching category.
cookiePolicy.duration_body: Google Analytics cookies are typically kept for up to 13 months. Your cookie consent choice itself is stored in your browser's local storage and applies until you change it, clear your browser data, or a future update to this policy requires asking again.
cookiePolicy.manage_body: You can change your cookie preferences at any time — from this page, or from the "Manage cookie preferences" link in the site footer. You can also block or delete cookies from your browser settings, though this may affect how the site works.
cookiePolicy.contact_body: For any question about this Cookie Policy, write to contact@alcaziurobert.ro.
